title: Option to enable pipewire-virtual-surround-sound feature
line: Sound settings can now add a Virtual Surround Sound output that plays 5.1 and 7.1 audio as surround on headphones.
explanation: PipeWire can turn multichannel audio into headphone surround with a filter-chain sink, but it only ships example configs that the user has to copy and edit by hand, and plasma-pa had no PipeWire-side settings at all (its Configure menu was hidden on PipeWire). The change adds a checkable "Add virtual output device for surround sound on headphones" entry to the Sound page's Configure menu on PipeWire. Enabling it writes ~/.config/pipewire/pipewire.conf.d/plasma-pa-virtual-surround.conf (a 7.1 sofa spatializer graph using libmysofa's default.sofa HRTF, mixed to stereo) and restarts WirePlumber and PipeWire through the same helper Rename Devices now uses; it then waits for the Virtual Surround Sound sink to appear, and if PipeWire couldn't create it (for example without its SOFA plugin) it removes the file, unchecks the entry and shows an error, as it also does when the restart itself fails. The error header can be closed, which clears the error.

commits.message:
kcm: add an option for virtual surround sound on PipeWire

PipeWire can render 5.1 and 7.1 audio as surround sound on headphones,
but Plasma had no way to enable it. Add a Configure menu entry that sets
up its spatializer filter, restarts PipeWire and reports any failure.

BUG: 527041

media.caption: Master on PipeWire: no Configure menu, no way to enable virtual surround
Configure menu now offers the virtual surround output (PulseAudio-only entries stay hidden on PipeWire)
After enabling it, a "Virtual Surround Sound" output appears and can be made the default
PipeWire without its SOFA spatializer plugin: enabling it now shows an error instead of silently doing nothing
If restarting the audio services fails, the error is reported and nothing is changed
Errors shown in the Sound page header now have a close button
Closing it dismisses the error; a later failure shows it again
